## Slide 1

Riverbend Youth Collective — Summer Bridge Logic Model RESOURCES Two full-time program coordinators based at the Riverbend site Annual operating grant from the Halloway Foundation Donated classroom space at Riverbend Community Centre A volunteer roster of thirty trained reading mentors ACTIVITIES Six-week summer literacy intensive for rising fourth graders Weekly one-to-one mentoring pairings throughout the term Monthly family literacy evenings held at the community centre Quarterly professional development for volunteer mentors OUTPUTS One hundred and twenty rising fourth graders enrolled each summer Two thousand four hundred mentoring contact hours delivered Eight family literacy evenings hosted across the year Thirty volunteer mentors completing the full training sequence SHORT-TERM OUTCOMES Participants read aloud with visibly greater fluency by August Families report knowing which books suit their child's level Mentors describe themselves as confident leading a session LONG-TERM OUTCOMES Participants enter middle school reading at or above grade level Riverbend families sustain a habit of reading together at home
